race.comment: HYDRATING (5) is a five start maiden formerly with the Brisbourne stable having first try for the new local yard. Well placed here and has the blinkers on. Goes close. NOT HAPPENING (7) has placed at both runs this time in looks close to a win. Placed this circuit two back and should be in the finish again. MISHPAT (6) ran a better race last time finishing runner-up. Tricky gate but will push forward and give a sight. WINNING FLAME (9) led to the turn over 1800m at Sunshine Coast last time out but faded to finish sixth. Drops right back in trip and will appreciate the drop in grade. Bold showing expected. ALVITAR (4) is a recent trial winner and can give a sight fresh.
